title: The Travers Murder
music: Sparse crime film score, low piano and quiet strings, tense and slow, no vocals, instrumental only

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: June twenty-second, nineteen sixty-five. Jeremy Travers's sixtieth birthday. He had dinner at his country house with Amanda, his wife; Barbara, his daughter; Gordon, his business partner; and Claudia, his secretary. The next morning, Amanda Travers went to her husband's bedroom. She found him dead.

segments.sfx: Quiet old country house at night, a slow clock tick, no music, no voices

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Detective Granger arrived at about nine o'clock. He was a tall man with a big mustache. Amanda, Barbara, Claudia, and Gordon were in the living room.

segments.sfx: A heavy wooden door opens and one person steps onto a wooden floor, no music

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The detective came in.

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: Mr. Travers died between midnight last night and seven o'clock this morning. Somebody in this room killed him.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He looked at them one by one, but nobody spoke.

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: Mrs. Travers, I want to talk to you first. Come into the library with me, please.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Amanda followed the detective into the library and they sat down.

segments.sfx: A wooden chair pulled back, then two people sitting, quiet room, no music

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: What did your husband do after dinner last night?

segments.speaker: amanda
segments.text: We finished dinner at about nine thirty. Then Jeremy said he was tired and he went to bed.

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: Did you go to bed then?

segments.speaker: amanda
segments.text: No, I didn't. I went for a walk in the yard.

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: What time did you go to bed?

segments.speaker: amanda
segments.text: At about a quarter to twelve.

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: Was your husband asleep?

segments.speaker: amanda
segments.text: I don't know, Detective. We slept in different rooms. But I saw that his door was closed.

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: Did you hear anything when you were in your room?

segments.speaker: amanda
segments.text: Yes, I heard Jeremy's bedroom door. It opened. I thought it was Jeremy. Then it closed again. I read in bed for half an hour and then I went to sleep.

segments.sfx: A bedroom door opening and closing softly down a hallway, no music

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: What time did you get up this morning?

segments.speaker: amanda
segments.text: I got up at about seven fifteen. I had breakfast and at eight o'clock I took a cup of tea to my husband. I found him in bed. He was dead.

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: Tell me, Mrs. Travers, did you love your husband?

segments.speaker: amanda
segments.text: Jeremy is... was a difficult man.

segments.speaker: granger
segments.text: But did you love him, Mrs. Travers?

segments.speaker: amanda
segments.text: No, Detective. I hated him.
